research_rationale:
EO 12075 (Interagency Coordinating Council), signed 1978-08-16. The order establishes the Interagency Coordinating Council (Section 1-101), lists its member agencies (1-102), provides for a Chairperson (1-103), sets functions (1-201 to 1-205), administrative provisions (1-301 to 1-303) and a report by the Chairperson to the President (1-304). Its held text has no sunset or termination provision. EO 12148 Section 5-210 later added an agency to the membership list in Section 1-102. First end: Section 14 of EO 12379 (signed 1982-08-17, Termination of Boards, Committees, and Commissions) names this order by number, "Executive Order No. 12075," and provides that it is revoked. EO 12379 has no effective-date clause, so the revocation took effect on signing, 1982-08-17. They are leads only; the end, the later events and the savings were decided from the held Federal Register texts named in this claim. Search of the held order texts for this order's number (the packet records a bounded number-citation search over its lookup corpus, excluding clause-draft copies): apart from the order's own copies, the matching files are EO 11022, EO 11256, EO 11829, EO 12148, EO 12379. The files filed under EO 11022, EO 11256 and EO 11829 matched only because they carry the same Federal Register pages as the EO 12379 revocation list; they are not separate instruments naming this order.
